description: This file defines the SystemInfo class and related functions for retrieving system information such as memory, CPU load, uptime, and hardware details within the WPEFramework project. It includes declarations for external functions, constants, and a nested MemorySnapshot class, serving as an interface for system-related data access.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Provides methods to retrieve system metrics such as memory, CPU load, uptime, and hardware details. Implements singleton pattern and includes nested MemorySnapshot class for capturing memory state.

classes.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of system memory statistics, with methods to output data as JSON and access individual metrics.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SystemInfo.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetHostName
methods.description: Returns the hostname of the system.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetPageSize
methods.description: Returns the system's memory page size.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetPhysicalPageCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of physical memory pages.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetTotalSwap
methods.description: Returns total swap space in bytes.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetFreeSwap
methods.description: Returns free swap space in bytes.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetJiffies
methods.description: Returns the number of jiffies (clock ticks).

methods.name: SystemInfo::TakeMemorySnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of current memory statistics.
